reviews.title: Limited & Extortion
reviews.text:
Free version is limited and the paid version is way to expensive for what it is. For that reason a 1 star rating is justified. Sorry but if you’re paying for the premium version then you’re bonkers. 🤗

I left this review over a year ago and they now respond with a narcissist sarcastic message 🤣
